title: The Sweet Summer Minis Lip Butter Balm Trio Set

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, nonComedogenic, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree

descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Long-wearing✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Good for: Dryness
What it is: A sweet set that features mini sizes of the award-winning Lip Butter Balm in three new limited-edition shades.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, phthalates, and sulfates SLS & SLES.

What Else You Need to Know: This silky, vegan lip balm immediately nourishes and softens dry lips. The limited-edition set includes three new shades: Sea Salt Caramel, a neutral rose with salted-caramel flavor; Peach Granita, a warm coral with a hint of peach sweetness; and Berry Sorbet, a cool pink with a touch of berry flavor.

This Set Contains:
- 3 x 0.16 oz/ 5 mL Lip Butter Balm in Berry Sorbet, Peach Granita, Sea Salt Caramel
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply as needed throughout the day. Pair with any lip product.
Ingredients+
Lip Butter Balm Berry Sorbet:
Phytosteryl/Isostearyl/Cetyl/Stearyl/Behenyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Diisostearyl Malate, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Polybutene, Hydrogenated Poly(C6-14 Olefin), Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Microcrystalline Wax/Cera Microcristallina/Cire microcristalline, Octyldodecanol, Synthetic Wax, Disteardimonium Hectorite, Astrocaryum Murumuru Seed Butter, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol, Flavor/Aroma, Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, Mica, Polyglyceryl-2 Diisostearate, Propylene Carbonate, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Aluminum Hydroxide, BHT, Stevia Rebaudiana Leaf Extract, Benzyl Benzoate, Citronellol, Limonene, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77499), Red 7 (CI 15850), Red 28 Lake (CI 45410).

Lip Butter Balm Peach Granita:
Phytosteryl/Isostearyl/Cetyl/Stearyl/Behenyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Diisostearyl Malate, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Polybutene, Hydrogenated Poly(C6-14 Olefin), Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Microcrystalline Wax/Cera Microcristallina/Cire microcristalline, Octyldodecanol, Synthetic Wax, Disteardimonium Hectorite, Astrocaryum Murumuru Seed Butter, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol, Vanillin, Flavor/Aroma, Mica, Polyglyceryl-2 Diisostearate, Propylene Carbonate, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, BHT, Stevia Rebaudiana Leaf Extract, Linalool, Terpineol, Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77499), Red 6 (CI 15850), Red 28 Lake (CI 45410).

Lip Butter Balm Sea Salt Caramel:
Phytosteryl/Isostearyl/Cetyl/Stearyl/Behenyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Diisostearyl Malate, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Polybutene, Hydrogenated Poly(C6-14 Olefin), Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Microcrystalline Wax/Cera Microcristallina/Cire microcristalline, Octyldodecanol, Synthetic Wax, Disteardimonium Hectorite, Astrocaryum Murumuru Seed Butter, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol, Vanillin, Flavor/Aroma, Mica, Polyglyceryl-2 Diisostearate, Propylene Carbonate, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, BHT, Stevia Rebaudiana Leaf Extract, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499).
